protocol.bkz_internal_lll: fpylll.LLL.Reduction on the same explicitly MPFR GSO
protocol.decoder_internal_precision: separate future decoder configuration, not specified by this protocol
protocol.early_termination: exception or external termination only; no public-success callback in this interface
protocol.historical_anchor: beta32tour2 was a progressive warm-start success, not a measured cold-start minimum
protocol.strategy_extension: above loaded strategy maximum: Strategy(beta, [], []), unpruned, no preprocessing blocks
protocol.strategy_resolution: backend metadata records actual strategy file bytes and SHA256
protocol.strict_tour_definition: one completed explicit BKZReduction.tour call; clean does not skip later calls

count_definitions.completed_count: external targets returned with an explicit decoder status; zero in phase 2A
count_definitions.exact_unique_count: complete integer tail vectors after exact deduplication, keep first
count_definitions.generated_raw_count: actual entries generated or received, before filtering
count_definitions.policy_kept_count: entries satisfying the nonzero weight policy, before exact deduplication
count_definitions.projection_group_count: backend projection groups; null until actually computed
count_definitions.submitted_count: external targets actually submitted to a decoder; zero in phase 2A

candidate_batch.ordered_sha256_scope: context plus ordered complete tails and candidate IDs; excludes policy/run progress
candidate_batch.public_sha256_scope: canonical public-v1 JSON content, not file bytes

selection.pattern_rule: random.Random(seed); per index sample(range(n),k), then draw backend seed
selection.tail_rule: largest kappa surviving original f coordinates, increasing order
